about: Image-editing benchmarks (comfyui_edit, omni_edit): edit i uses edits[i % len] with seed benchmate.prompts.generation_seed(i), so every model gets the same input image, instruction and seed in the same order and their kept outputs compare edit by edit. The inputs are 1024x1024 Z-Image-Turbo outputs (Apache-2.0 model) from homelab-comfyui-z-image-turbo, run of 2026-11-11: the first four shared prompts of benchmate.prompts.IMAGE_PROMPTS with their seeds 1000-1003.

fox.png.prompt: a red fox in a snowy forest at golden hour, photorealistic

lighthouse.png.prompt: a lighthouse on a rocky coast during a storm, dramatic clouds, oil painting

ramen.png.prompt: a bowl of ramen on a wooden table, steam rising, close-up food photography

astronaut.png.prompt: an astronaut riding a horse across a desert at sunset, cinematic

edits.instruction: Change the fox's fur to pure white, like an arctic fox. Keep everything else the same.
Make it a calm sunny day with a clear blue sky and a smooth sea. Keep the lighthouse, the house and the oil painting style.
Add a pair of red chopsticks resting across the top of the bowl.
Replace the horse with a camel. Keep the astronaut, his pose and the desert at sunset.
Remove the fox, leaving only the snowy forest.
Turn this oil painting into a realistic photograph of the same scene.
Write the word "RAMEN" in bold white letters on the side of the bowl.
Make it night: a dark starry sky with a full moon, the desert lit by moonlight.
